business.summary: President Donald Trump announced plans to penalize companies building AI data centers outside the U.S., even as local U.S. jurisdictions place restrictions on new facilities.

models.title: Harness-Hub Releases Qwen3.8-27B-Pi-Adapted LoRA for Coding Agents
models.summary: A new LoRA adapter trained with reinforcement learning matches maximum-effort base model thinking while generating about 4.5x fewer tokens, substantially improving SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 2.1 scores.
models.why: It drastically reduces token overhead while maintaining high reasoning performance on software engineering tasks.

models.title: Meituan-Longcat Releases LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.6 for Human Video Generation
models.summary: LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.6 upgrades audio-driven human video generation with more stable lip animation, enhanced expressive naturalness, and comprehensive inference optimizations for long-form video.
models.why: It improves temporal stability and synchronization for audio-driven human video synthesis frameworks.

models.title: Higurashi-ai Launches Haru-4B Full-Duplex Continuous Spoken Dialogue Model
models.summary: Haru-4B is a low-latency, multilingual full-duplex spoken dialogue model that listens and speaks simultaneously at 7.5 Hz using continuous audio frames and a small MLP head with MeanFlow.
models.why: It advances real-time conversational audio capabilities by eliminating waiting turns between listening and speaking.

models.title: Tencent Introduces Hy4 Flash Cost-Effective Multimodal Model
models.summary: Hy4 Flash is a cost-effective multimodal model featuring 220B total parameters and 12B active parameters per token, natively accepting text and image inputs with optimized performance.
models.why: It offers an efficient large-scale architecture option with reduced active parameter overhead.

models.title: Inworld AI Releases Open-License Voice Isolator Models
models.summary: Inworld Voice Isolator v1 provides 48 kHz voice isolation for noisy recordings and live audio streams, designed to clean audio pipelines while preserving speaker identity.
models.why: It provides a robust open-license tool for preprocessing speech datasets and real-time audio streams.

models.title: Qwen Releases Qwen3.8-27B Base Model Weights
models.summary: Qwen has released the model weights and configuration files for Qwen3.8-27B, compatible with standard inference frameworks like vLLM, SGLang, and Hugging Face Transformers.
models.why: It delivers a new base model option for deployment across popular high-throughput serving engines.
